title: Niagara-On-The-Lake Guided Wine and Charcuterie Full-Day Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
LIMITED TIME BONUS: All guests receive a $10 gift card for the Outlet Collection at Niagara!

Book now to enjoy a day touring through the immaculate wine region of Niagara-On-The-Lake. Experience a selection from 100 wineries in the region, with inspirations from Italy, France, Spain, Germany, and California. Feel safe and secure with your professional driver who is also your knowledgable tour guide as well. 

The Niagara wine region boasts awards from all over the world for taste and innovation, guaranteeing you a wine tour you will never forget!

This is a daily tour includes visits to 3 different wineries, 9-12 different wine tastings, Icewine tastings, one charcuterie pairing and a 75-minute break in Niagara-On-The-Lake's "Old Town" (downtown) for lunch.
